# Resonate

> Resonate is a free, open-source social voice platform: live audio rooms, scheduled rooms, stories and chapters, friends and calls, audio spaces and room moderation. It is built and maintained by AOSSIE (Australian Open Source Software Innovation and Education), a not-for-profit that brings open-source projects together. This site is the project's landing page.

The mobile app is available for Android on Google Play. Everything, including the app, its backend and this website, is open source on GitHub.

## Pages on this site

- [Home (English)](https://resonate.aossie.org/en): what Resonate is, store rating and community numbers, the AOSSIE organisation, the feature set and the tech stack.
- [Home (Hindi)](https://resonate.aossie.org/hi): the same page in Hindi.
- [Sitemap](https://resonate.aossie.org/sitemap.xml): machine-readable list of localized pages.

## Get the app

- [Resonate on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.resonate.resonate): Android download.

## Source code

- [Resonate app (Flutter)](https://github.com/AOSSIE-Org/Resonate): the mobile application.
- [Resonate backend](https://github.com/AOSSIE-Org/Resonate-Backend): server-side code and infrastructure.
- [Resonate website](https://github.com/AOSSIE-Org/Resonate-Website): this landing page, a Next.js static export.
- [AOSSIE on GitHub](https://github.com/AOSSIE-Org): all organisation repositories.

## Community and organisation

- [AOSSIE website](https://aossie.org): about the organisation behind Resonate.
- [AOSSIE Discord](https://discord.gg/hjUhu33uAn): community chat, the recommended place to ask questions or get started contributing.
- [AOSSIE on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@AOSSIE-Org): talks and project videos.
- [AOSSIE on X (Twitter)](https://twitter.com/aossie_org): announcements.
- [AOSSIE on GitLab](https://gitlab.com/aossie): mirrored repositories.
- Contact: aossie.oss@gmail.com

## Tech stack

- App: Flutter and Dart.
- Backend: Appwrite.
- Real-time audio: LiveKit.
- Website: Next.js 16 (App Router, static export), React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, next-intl for English and Hindi, next-themes for light and dark mode, Lenis for smooth scrolling.

- [Brand guidelines](https://github.com/AOSSIE-Org/Resonate-Website/blob/main/public/brand/Brand.md): colours, logos and typography for Resonate and AOSSIE.
